caption: The drawing depicts a round, wooden spice box with a metallic rim and an accompanying, slightly tilted lid resting to its right. The box is labeled "SPICES" in uppercase block letters on the front side. Inside the open box, there are eight smaller cylindrical containers, each made of metal with wooden lids, tightly arranged in a circular formation. The lids are labeled with various spice names and have a brownish to reddish and yellowish tint, corresponding with the types of spices they contain. The overall color palette consists primarily of shades of brown, tan, and gray, with the text and details finely outlined. The background is plain and off-white, keeping the focus on the spice box and its contents.
title: Spice Box
